scope: All 28 assigned presets reviewed against bounded identity candidates from the complete shared canonical detail corpus. Original-case identity is distinct from vicinity, chronology, observation independence and narrative truth. No source dates, coordinates, filters, datasets or app files were changed.

inputs.compressionHashMethod: SHA256 of existing gzip bytes read once per file; no live R2 bytes fetched
inputs.readPassNote: The first completed pass was not saved because its candidate serialization exceeded an artificial limit. One authorized recovery pass preserved the candidates; accepted/excluded review was then completed from that compact file. Carter received a two-chunk targeted supplement after a summary-location check. No corpus copies or live R2 downloads.

searchMethod.candidateWindow: Strong case/witness tokens within preset range plus/minus 366 days (or missing date); additional location/narrative tokens only preset range plus/minus 1 day. Later strong-token mentions counted and sampled separately. This is a bounded identity search, not proof of absence.
searchMethod.geometry: Wrapped local projected distance matching app localProjectedMeters, sphere R6371008.8m; distances are diagnostic, not identity evidence.
searchMethod.carterSupplement: A supplementary summary-location check for the whole word Leary identified two outside-year UFOCAT rows, inspected in place in chunks000061 and000166. These supplement, rather than replace, the named-account review.
searchMethod.mappingRule: Mapped outside-vicinity points are not automatically errors. needs_review is reserved for a reviewed source/location contradiction or an existing proven discrepancy; stored coordinates remain unchanged.
